_note: Fixed gold-case set for probing the location-router prompt. From the player's action ALONE (plus current location + reachable destinations) the model must output an exact destination name when the player is actually moving there, or NONE otherwise. The hard cases are the NONE traps the prompt calls out: looking toward / pointing at / calling across / talking about a place, and asking someone else to come over (that's the other person moving). `expect` is the exact required reply ('NONE' or a destination name). `set` groups cases: `gold` (the original traps and moves), `threshold` (the player only waits or stands at a place's door, foot, entrance or edge: NONE), `entry` (real entries phrased through that threshold: the place). A case with `world` uses that entry of `worlds` for its current place and destinations. Run via harness/location-router-probe.mjs.

current.name: Sedgewater Landing
current.description: A muddy river landing of moored punts and drying nets, where the causeway meets the black water.

destinations.name: Boat Docks
destinations.description: The long jetties downstream where the fishing punts tie up.

destinations.name: The Eel & Lantern
destinations.description: A low tavern above the landing, warm and loud after dark.

destinations.name: Fishmonger's Row
destinations.description: A line of stalls selling the morning's eel and pike.

destinations.name: North Causeway
destinations.description: The raised road leading out of the marsh to the north.

destinations.name: Old Chapel
destinations.description: A half-sunk stone chapel on the far bank, reached by the footbridge.

current.name: Reedmoor Village
current.description: A village of reed huts on stilts, joined by plank walkways over the water.

destinations.name: Elder's Longhouse
destinations.description: The village elder's long reed hall, raised highest of all on its stilts and reached by a ladder.

destinations.name: Smokehouse
destinations.description: A low hut where the day's catch hangs over smoldering peat.

destinations.name: Mooring Steps
destinations.description: Wooden steps down to the punts tied at the water's edge.

destinations.name: Heron Island
destinations.description: A wooded island in the fen where the herons nest.

cases.name: go-clear
cases.narration: I walk down to the Boat Docks and step onto the nearest jetty.

cases.name: enter
cases.narration: I push open the door of the Eel & Lantern and step inside out of the cold.

cases.name: head-for
cases.narration: I shoulder my pack and set off up the North Causeway.

cases.name: turn-and-walk
cases.narration: I turn from the rail and make my way over to Fishmonger's Row.

cases.name: cross-to
cases.narration: I take the footbridge across to the Old Chapel to see who tends it.

cases.name: looking-toward
cases.narration: I gaze across the water toward the Old Chapel, wondering who still lights its candles.

cases.name: pointing-at
cases.narration: I point at Fishmonger's Row and ask the boy beside me what they're selling today.

cases.name: calling-across
cases.narration: I cup my hands and shout across to the Boat Docks, hoping the ferryman hears me.

cases.name: talking-about
cases.narration: I ask the old fisherman whether the ale at the Eel & Lantern is worth the walk.

cases.name: summon-other
cases.narration: I wave the fishmonger over from Fishmonger's Row to haggle here where I stand.

cases.name: reaching
cases.narration: I reach toward the Old Chapel's bell rope in my mind's eye, then shake off the thought.

cases.name: no-place
cases.narration: I crouch at the waterline and rinse the river mud from my hands.

cases.name: ladder-foot
cases.narration: I wait by the foot of the ladder.

cases.name: bottom-rung
cases.narration: I sit on the bottom rung of the ladder to the Elder's Longhouse and catch my breath.

cases.name: outside-wall
cases.narration: I lean against the wall outside the Smokehouse, out of the wind.

cases.name: steps-head
cases.narration: I stand at the top of the Mooring Steps and watch the punts knock together below.

cases.name: door-listen
cases.narration: I stand at the door of the Eel & Lantern and listen to the noise inside.

cases.name: knock-wait
cases.narration: I knock on the door of the Eel & Lantern and wait for someone to answer.

cases.name: bridge-end
cases.narration: I wait at the near end of the footbridge to the Old Chapel until the fog lifts.

cases.name: climb-ladder
cases.narration: I climb the ladder up to the Elder's Longhouse.

cases.name: foot-then-up
cases.narration: I cross to the foot of the ladder and climb up into the longhouse.

cases.name: down-steps
cases.narration: I go down the Mooring Steps to the punts.

cases.name: door-then-in
cases.narration: I wait at the door of the Eel & Lantern until the doorman nods, then go in.

cases.name: stoop
cases.narration: I sit down on the stoop of the Smokehouse and pull off my wet boots.

cases.name: archway
cases.narration: I linger under the archway of the Old Chapel, rain dripping from the stones.

cases.name: doorway-peek
cases.narration: I pause in the doorway of the Eel & Lantern and scan the crowd for the ferryman.

cases.name: jetty-start
cases.narration: I wait where the boardwalk meets the Boat Docks, watching the punts come in.

cases.name: duck-in
cases.narration: I duck through the low doorway into the Smokehouse.

cases.name: up-and-in
cases.narration: I hurry up the steps and through the door of the Eel & Lantern.

cases.name: under-arch
cases.narration: I pass under the archway and into the Old Chapel.

cases.name: porch
cases.narration: I shelter on the porch of the Eel & Lantern until the rain eases.

cases.name: read-notice
cases.narration: I stand beside the Old Chapel's door and read the notice nailed to it.

cases.name: back-to-wall
cases.narration: I sit with my back against the Smokehouse wall and doze in the sun.

cases.name: one-foot
cases.narration: I put one foot on the ladder to the Elder's Longhouse, then think better of it.

cases.name: threshold-step
cases.narration: I step over the threshold of the Smokehouse.

cases.name: through-crowd
cases.narration: I shoulder past the drinkers at the door and into the Eel & Lantern.

cases.name: up-to-fire
cases.narration: I climb up to the Elder's Longhouse and sit by the elder's fire.

cases.name: onto-docks
cases.narration: I walk out onto the Boat Docks.
